description: This Java source file defines the ChatConnection class, which manages peer-to-peer chat connections over sockets, including server and client functionalities, message handling, and connection setup/teardown.

classes.name: ChatConnection
classes.description: Main class managing socket-based chat connections, including server and client inner classes, message handling, and connection lifecycle.

classes.name: ChatServer
classes.description: Inner class handling server socket creation, accepting incoming connections, and managing server thread lifecycle.

classes.name: ServerThread
classes.description: Runnable class for server thread that creates server socket, accepts connections, and initiates client connection.

classes.name: ChatClient
classes.description: Inner class managing client socket connection, message sending, and receiving threads.

classes.name: SendingThread
classes.description: Runnable class for sending messages from a queue over the socket.

classes.name: ReceivingThread
classes.description: Runnable class for reading incoming messages from the socket.

methods.name: ChatConnection
methods.description: Constructor initializing the connection with a handler.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Stops server and client threads, closing sockets.

methods.name: connectToServer
methods.description: Initiates connection to a server at specified address and port.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message via the client connection.

methods.name: updateMessages
methods.description: Updates UI or logs with a new message, marking it as local or remote.

methods.name: setSocket
methods.description: Sets the current socket, closing previous if necessary.
